mapper.select: SELECT subject_id AS subject_id, COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(correct), 0) AS correct FROM report_subject_daily WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY subject_id ORDER BY total DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_subject_daily (user_id, date, subject_id, total, correct) VALUES (#{userId}, #{date}, #{subjectId}, #{total}, #{correct})
